runtime_default: Conservative: preserve observed state, record uncertainty, and route to a human owner; do not invent a technical profile.

hooks.question: Which fields are required for every MWM figure and table record?
hooks.default_behavior: Record available fields and mark missing requirements not_ready.

hooks.question: Are live Word fields required at author handoff, or may static references be accepted?
hooks.default_behavior: Test field state; do not silently convert or accept static text.

hooks.question: Which output-format accessibility standard and test method is active?
hooks.default_behavior: Flag format-specific accessibility gaps without claiming conformance.

hooks.question: What caption/title placement and separation profile applies?
hooks.default_behavior: Record observed placement and escalate conflicts.

hooks.question: What is the alt-text versus long-description workflow and owner?
hooks.default_behavior: Flag missing description records and route; never write semantic alt text from inference.

hooks.question: Who owns permissions decisions and what evidence threshold is sufficient?
hooks.default_behavior: Set rights status unknown or pending and escalate.

hooks.question: Which statistical and measurement notation rules are adopted for each domain?
hooks.default_behavior: Preserve original notation and route ambiguity.

hooks.question: Which note types, locations, and appendix relationships are required?
hooks.default_behavior: Record structure and flag unscoped note/appendix behavior.

hooks.question: What production architecture governs cross-document references and compilation?
hooks.default_behavior: Do not infer cross-document target/update behavior.

hooks.question: Are automatic asset resolution, dimensions, and width checks required, and at what stage?
hooks.default_behavior: Record metadata and flag unconfigured checks.
